lessons.title: Sigmund Freud & The Unconscious Mind
lessons.description: Trace Freud's transition from neurology to psychoanalysis, Anna O., free association, and the iceberg model.

lessons.title: Psychic Structures: Id, Ego & Superego
lessons.description: Examine the dynamic structural model of personality, pleasure and reality principles, and intrapsychic conflict.

lessons.title: Defense Mechanisms & Psychosexual Stages
lessons.description: Master ego defense mechanisms, psychosexual fixation stages, and Popper's critique of unfalsifiability.

lessons.title: The Neo-Freudians: Jung, Adler & Horney
lessons.description: Analyze departures from biological determinism: Jung's archetypes, Adler's inferiority complex, and Horney's feminist critique.
